notAdmin: Only an institute admin can manage classroom panels.

common.stale: Could not refresh. This may be out of date.

errors.BUSY: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.DEVICE_NOT_ACTIVE: This panel was removed, so it cannot be changed.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You need to be an admin of this institute to do this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This was not found. It may have been removed already.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.ROOM_HAS_DEVICE: This room has a panel. Move or remove the panel first.
errors.ROOM_NAME_TAKEN: A room with this name already exists.
errors.ROOM_OCCUPIED: This room already has a panel. Pick another room, or remove that panel first.

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Classroom panels paired to this institute, and who is signed in on them.

empty.title: No panels yet
empty.body: A panel must first show a setup code. Open the Classroom app on the panel, then add it here with that code.

panels.liveClassHint: Live classes start from the teacher's device
panels.passwordToggle: Allow password sign-in on the panel in {{room}}

move.title: Move the panel in {{room}}
move.noFreeRooms: Every room has a panel. Add a room first.
move.help: No visit to the panel is needed. It shows the new room name within a minute.

revoke.title: Remove the panel in {{room}}?
revoke.body: Whoever is signed in on it is signed out, and it returns to its setup screen within a minute. {{room}} becomes free. To use this panel again you need a new setup code.

endSession.title: End the session in {{room}}?
endSession.body: {{teacher}} is signed out of the panel in {{room}} within a minute.

code.intro: Open the Classroom app on the panel. It shows a setup code and a number.
code.label: Setup code
code.invalid: Enter the 8-character code shown on the panel.
code.notFound: No panel is showing this code. Check it, or use the new code on the panel.

details.numberHelp: Tap the same number you can see on the panel.
details.numberRequired: Tap the number shown on the panel.
details.warning: Only pair a panel you can see right now. If someone sent you this code by message or phone, stop here.
details.wrongNumber: That number didn't match. The panel now shows a new code. Enter it to try again.
details.expired: This code has expired or was already used. Enter the new code shown on the panel.

replace.title: Replace the panel in {{room}}?
replace.body: {{room}} already has a panel: {{model}}, {{seen}}. Replacing removes that panel and signs out anyone using it. It needs a new setup code to be used again.

done.title: Now tap Confirm on the panel
done.activeBody: Teachers can now sign in on this panel.
done.declinedBody: {{room}} is free again. Use the new code on the panel to try again.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Each room holds one panel. The room name is what teachers see on the panel and on their phone.

empty.title: No rooms yet
empty.body: Add your rooms now, or name a new room when you add a panel. A panel must first show a setup code.

paste.title: Paste a list of rooms
paste.label: Room names
paste.help: One room per line, up to {{max}}. Names that already exist are skipped.
paste.required: Enter at least one room name.
paste.tooMany: Paste at most {{max}} rooms at a time.
paste.lineTooLong: Use at most {{max}} characters for each room: {{name}}

archive.title: Archive {{room}}?
archive.body: The room is removed from this list. Past sessions are kept, and you can add a room with the same name later.
